array.string: # Wait up to 30s for the Hermes gateway to be ready for i in $(seq 1 30); do if lsof -i :8642 -P 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then break fi sleep 1 done # Small extra delay for workspace to settle sleep 3 # Open the dashboard in Chrome (forces a new tab) osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to activate' \ -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to open location "http://127.0.0.1:8899/system-dashboard.html"'
